Dr. Michael Schulman of Revive Medical Center in Lawrenceville, GA said that when he first started with ChiroCandy, one office was barely making $20,000 a month. On ChiroCandy Podcast episode 183, he said that same office is on track for almost $3 million.
Multi-discipline office: chiropractic plus nurse practitioner, medical doctor, physical therapy, weight loss, joint injections, and Shockwave, shifted toward cash services.

Dr. Schulman had already tried doing social media marketing himself (courses, CRM certificates, automations) and had cycled through five to ten other companies. Some disappeared. Some charged a lot for little result. He left ChiroCandy once because he did not want to film videos and another shop promised done-for-you content. That shop, in his words, promised everything and gave him nothing.

ChiroCandy ran the ads, copy, and CRM automations, and adjusted weekly when something was not working. The account team sent weekly updates and used the video he and his videographer produced — including personality and staff interviews shot to feel like TikTok, not only offer ads.

He watches the weekly updates and says what is converting in the office, not only lead count. Two people on his team follow up in the CRM every day. He hired a videographer who films a few days a week. He came back to ChiroCandy willing to make the videos. One staff clip reached about four million views on TikTok, he said.

On the podcast he tied the growth to one office: from barely $20,000 a month at the start with ChiroCandy to a run rate of almost $3 million. That is his number, said on camera, not a ChiroCandy forecast. He also named the operating habits: CRM, daily follow-up, and consistent video.

The 3D-X Framework is ChiroCandy's chiropractic marketing execution model. Define what you are building, Deploy it across ads and content, then eXamine performance so every dollar gets smarter.
Define is where you set goals, choose your ideal patient, and decide what success looks like before you spend on ads.
Deploy is the launch phase where strategy becomes live ads, landing pages, email flows, and content.
eXamine is the review phase where you measure leads, cost per patient, and conversion rates, then adjust.

The 4-O Framework is ChiroCandy's four-pillar model for sustainable chiropractic growth. You win Online, convert with strong Offers, retain through Operations, then grow through patient Outcomes and referrals.
Online is your visibility layer: search rankings, ads, social presence, and a website that loads fast and answers patient questions.
Offers give prospects a clear reason to book now. Operations keep them showing up, paying, and staying in care.
Outcomes are the clinical and service results patients feel, plus the systems that ask for reviews and referrals at the right moment.

The 7-11-4 Framework explains how chiropractic patients build familiarity before they call. They need about 7 hours of content exposure, 11 interactions with your brand, and 4 different places where they see you.
The 7 stands for roughly seven hours of cumulative exposure to your content, ads, and educational material.
The 11 touchpoints are the separate moments a prospect interacts with your practice before they schedule.
The 4 refers to four distinct contexts or locations where patients encounter your brand.

These are the named systems ChiroCandy uses to help chiropractic practice owners move from unknown to trusted in their markets. Each framework is a repeatable model you can apply to ads, content, and patient experience.

Known / Found / Trusted is ChiroCandy's three-stage model for chiropractic practice growth. First patients know you exist, then they find you when they search, then they trust you enough to book and stay.
Known means your ideal patients recognize your name, face, or message before they need care.
Found means patients can discover you when they search Google, scroll social feeds, or ask for recommendations.
Trusted means prospects believe you are the safe, credible choice before they walk in.

The Perfect Patient Tribe Turbine is ChiroCandy's three-stage system for attracting ideal chiropractic patients. You define who you want, speak directly to them, then run campaigns that feed each other like a spinning turbine.
Your Perfect Patient Tribe is the specific group of people you serve best and want more of in your practice.
Tribe messaging speaks to the problems, goals, and language your ideal patients already use.
Campaign loops connect ads, content, follow-up, and referrals so each channel feeds the next.
